name: npx-forge
description: Package skills as npx-installable packages: the npx loader model, scope flags, and per-agent target paths.

interface.longDescription: Source of truth for distributing skills via npx: the loader model where `npx skills add <url>` downloads a repository/URL containing a SKILL.md and installs it into the target agent's config path. Documents URL references, global vs local scope, and per-agent target paths for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Hermes.
defaultPrompt: Use npx-forge to make a skill installable via npx.
